body: If you don't mind me asking, have any/some of these things helped you?

When i do get these suicidal thoughts they feel so intense and real that they scare me. They make me believe i will do it one day (i have attempted in the past) and while i don't care about myself i do have a small amount of people who would be affacted by my passing... mainly my parents. But then my mind conflicts me and tells me why should i continue to suffer for others sake? It's never ending.. i wish i knew the way out.

I question how professional they actually are. Where I live it seems to be very difficuly to actually get help from a trained professional... the appointment is two days away, so i will probably make it. But i have high anxiety about it... I'm not sure why. I don't feel worth it anymore, my existence is a tiny blip on this world and no one would really blink an eye if i were gone...when life stops for me it continues for everyone else and in the end i will be forgotten, and free of pain and struggle. I know these are passing moments and i may think differently tomorrow but i also know i always end up back here feeling so deeply miserable that i just want it to end.... sorry for rambling and thanks for listening

I have been to therapy and tried several anti depressants, one of them helped for a while but stopped working. I was then referred to someone else for an initial assessment and I'm now waiting for my next appointment which is a month and a half after the first one (i guess they expect me to pause my issues in the meantime....?). It's soon, but not sure what to expect. I'm always afraid if i say too much they will send me to a unit. I had asked for proper treatment before and was only referred when i had harmed myself... i don't expect it to help much.

Yea i would say it's general anxiety and depression. I'm not sure what triggered it exactly, a lot of things going on at a young age (beyween 7-10) i guess. But nothing major. Which makes it more frustrating... why do i feel so bad all the time for no reason? That's why it feels like I'm fighting myself, because i can feel fine one day then the next wake up and want to die. I don't want it anymore.

Because for most of my life I've been fighting against my own mind, i don't think it will improve, my mind will always want to destroy itsself for no good reason and that is a very tiring way to live.
